gwt.given: A shard set contains shard ids 7 and 11; ShardSetsBase<TConfiguration>.ShardSetReadFirst.QueryAsync is called for query Q; shard 7's per-shard read task resolves first with non-null model A while shard 11's per-shard read task is still in flight.
gwt.when: the read-first call observes shard 7's non-null result.
gwt.then: model A is returned, and the linked cancellation token source whose token was passed to both per-shard reads is cancelled, so shard 11's in-flight read is cancelled; whatever outcome shard 11's task reaches (cancelled, completed, or faulted) is observed and never surfaced to the caller.

sources.label: per-shard read tasks dispatched with the linked queryCancelationToken.Token, then handed to ShardFanOut.FirstNonNullAsync
once a result is chosen, the losing shards are cancelled through the linked source and their late outcomes observed
